description: Culture health indicators dashboard widget + Exportable culture report endpoint + export UI button. Depends on FEAT-001 (DB types). Independent of FEAT-006.
steps:
1. Create src/features/pulse/dashboard/components/CultureHealthWidget.tsx (server component, async function):

  Queries via supabaseAdmin (all relative to last 30 days unless noted):
  a. Active staff count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = true
  b. Low participation: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT from_user_id) FROM feedback WHERE visibility='public' AND created_at >= now()-'30 days'. If < 30% of active staff → warning.
  c. Neglected values: SELECT id, name FROM recognition_values WHERE is_active=true AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT value_id FROM feedback WHERE created_at >= now()-'30 days' AND value_id IS NOT NULL)
  d. Campaign drop-off: SELECT id, name FROM recognition_campaigns WHERE status='live' AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id FROM feedback WHERE created_at >= now()-'7 days' AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL)
  e. Teams needing follow-up: SELECT DISTINCT u.department FROM users u WHERE u.is_active=true AND u.department IS NOT NULL AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM checkins WHERE created_at >= now()-'14 days')
     Note: 'no check-in submissions in last 14 days' means no checkin rows in last 14 days from that department's users.

  Build indicators array: each indicator has { label, status: 'green'|'yellow'|'red', description }
  - 'Recognition participation': green if >=30% givers, yellow otherwise
  - 'All values in use': green if 0 neglected, yellow if 1-2, red if >2
  - 'Campaign engagement': green if 0 drop-off campaigns, yellow if >=1
  - 'Team check-ins': green if 0 neglected depts, yellow if 1-2, red if >2

  Render:
  - Section with header 'Culture health' + solar:heart-pulse-broken icon
  - Grid of indicator chips: each chip is a colored rounded badge (green=emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600, yellow=amber-500/10 text-amber-700, red=red-500/10 text-red-500)
  - Each chip: icon (solar:check-circle-broken for green, solar:danger-triangle-broken for yellow/red), label, description on hover or below
  - If all green: show a positive message 'Culture looks healthy this month'

  Add to PulseDashboard.tsx:
  - Import CultureHealthWidget
  - Render it for managers only (if isManager): after the milestones widget (which was added in FEAT-003).

2. Create src/app/api/pulse/reports/culture-export/route.ts (GET):
  - Auth: session required + can(role, 'view_analytics'); return 403 otherwise.
  - Accept query param `format` ('json' or 'csv', default 'json').
  - Gather report data:
    a. campaignSummary: SELECT id, name, status, starts_at, ends_at, COUNT(feedback) recognitions FROM recognition_campaigns LEFT JOIN feedback ON feedback.campaign_id = recognition_campaigns.id GROUP BY recognition_campaigns.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
       Use two queries in TS: campaigns + feedback grouped by campaign_id.
    b. recognitionSummary:
       - totalCount: COUNT from feedback WHERE visibility='public'
       - topValues: SELECT v.name, COUNT(f.id) FROM recognition_values v JOIN feedback f ON f.value_id=v.id GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 5
       - topGivers: SELECT u.name, COUNT(f.id) FROM feedback f JOIN users u ON u.id=f.from_user_id WHERE f.visibility='public' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 5
         Use TS-side aggregation to keep queries simple.
    c. voiceOutThemes: SELECT topic, status, COUNT(*) FROM voice_out_reports GROUP BY topic, status
    d. surveyParticipation: SELECT s.title, s.status, COUNT(sr.id) as responses FROM surveys s LEFT JOIN survey_responses sr ON sr.survey_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
    e. engagementTrend: weekly check-in counts for last 12 weeks — fetch checkins with created_at >= 12 weeks ago, group by ISO week in TS.
  - JSON response: `NextResponse.json({ generatedAt, campaignSummary, recognitionSummary, voiceOutThemes, surveyParticipation, engagementTrend })`
  - CSV response (format=csv): flatten into a simple format. Use a helper function buildCsv(rows: Record<string,unknown>[]): string that converts array of objects to CSV string. Return `new Response(csv, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/csv', 'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename=culture-report.csv' } })`.
  - For CSV, export the recognitionSummary.topGivers as the main data table (simple approach that satisfies the requirement).
acceptance_criteria: PulseDashboard.tsx imports and renders CultureHealthWidget for managers
ExportReportButton is rendered in the analytics page
